Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.login

Class LoginContentSecurityPolicy

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.login.LoginContentSecurityPolicy
@Component public class LoginContentSecurityPolicy extends Object
Builds the content security policy of the server-rendered pages from the BrandingProperties: same-origin resources only and no framing, except that images may also be data: URIs (the QR code of an authenticator app, rendered in memory so its secret never becomes a resource of its own) and, when the branding logo is an absolute http(s) URL, come from its origin (img-src 'self' data: <scheme://host[:port]>). A relative logo URL is same-origin and needs nothing more.
